'''''Yellow Rover''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], whose arrival in the [[Lucaya system]] signaled to [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], that the attack force was a mere half an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] away.<ref name="WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
